venue: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium, Gainesville FL
title: Week 1 vs FAU
dek: Sumrall’s first one looked like a team that came to hit somebody.
watchNote: PROVISIONAL — new draft for Charles. Fan rail stays empty.
headline: The Swamp got a first night that felt different. Florida ran the football, they went and got the ball, and they played like they were enjoying it. The score was 66–21. The tape is a back, a quarterback who got rid of it, and a defense that still has to finish the ugly yards.

offense.body:
Start with Baugh. He looks like he has been in Faulkner’s offense for two years, not one Saturday. He takes the handoff and he is already deciding. Sometimes that is through the middle and you hear the pad. Sometimes the hole is gone and he is outside before FAU can close it. Sometimes they bring a safety down to help and there is grass behind them and he is gone. One hundred sixty yards. Three scores. It never looks like a back they are trying to feature. It looks like the play.

The line is in that. Harris, Lovett, Moore, Shanahan, Ugorji — they are moving people. You do not need a coach’s copy to see it. Baugh is still running after the first man arrives. The receivers and tight ends are in it too. They stay on people. Stockton gets north after a short catch. Brown takes a carry and looks like a back. That is why the run does not die as soon as one guy shows up.

Philo is not trying to win the game with his arm. He is trying to keep the thing on schedule. Sixteen of 21. The ball is out. Wilson. Stockton. Harpring. Clark leaking out. He sees it and he is gone to the next one. Hold it, and Sweeney is waiting. That pick before the half is the night’s warning. This offense is the throw that leaves his hand. It is not the one he admires.

Brown is the after. The big touchdown is a throw that is there and a miss and then he is in space and the Swamp is loud. He does it again later. That is not a deep-ball show. That is a receiver who turns a catch into a problem. Abrams is the other side of the same idea — they finally crowd Baugh and the ball goes over the top and he is running.

Clark has to be in this. He runs. He is not the other guy they put in so Baugh can breathe. He goes downhill. He has a long one. He scores on the ground and he scores when they forget he can leave the backfield. If Baugh is the play, Clark is proof they have another one.

They almost gave a short-yardage chance away on a bad snap and Baugh got them back to the line and Philo walked it in. Messy. Still their night. Faulkner did not dress this up. He ran it, he threw it when it was there, and he let the skill people finish.
bullets: Baugh looks like he has been in this offense for years.
Philo keeps it on schedule. Hold it and they take it.
Brown after the catch. Clark runs.
The line and the skill guys stay on people.

defense.body:
White’s people come after you. They are not waiting to see what FAU wants to be. Graham and Chiles are running. The line is in the backfield enough that you notice names. James is in the backfield. Lyons is in the backfield. Bett is there at the end, on the quarterback, ball on the ground, Myles Johnson on it. That is a defense that wants the fight.

They will let you throw it short. The corners are not pressed up. FAU can take the five and the seven and stay on the field. That is real. What Florida does with the next throw is go get it. Coleman is standing there when Veltkamp waits. Johnson goes up and takes the other one. They run to the football. They tackle when they get there.

The 21 points are the ugly ones. Everybody in a pile at the 1 and Ervin still gets in. The end leaves and Veltkamp runs it in. Flowers loses the back corner and Valsin scores. None of that is a mystery. It is the stuff you have to finish when the other team is already in your yard. They finished the last one. They did not finish the first three.

That is the tape on this side. Fast. Physical. Hungry for the ball. Still leaky when the quarterback runs and when the play is a yard. Campbell will try both.
bullets: They come after you. James, Lyons, Bett show up.
Short throws stay alive. The held ball does not.
The 21 is the pile, the quarterback run, and the back-corner throw.
Campbell will try the short one and the keep.

specials.body: They had a long try and they took it. Durkin from 53. Florida never punted. They did not get cute on fourth down when the points were there.

keys: Baugh looks like he built this offense.
Philo throws it and lives. He holds it and they take it.
The defense wants the fight. They still have to finish the yard and the quarterback run.
Campbell will throw it short and keep it.

nextWeek.look: They will play fast and throw it short. Baugh is still the night. The end has to stay home when the quarterback runs.
